LanguageData.Ordo_DisallowedZone_ExpandDesc: Paint the disallowed zone. While the zone is switched on, it's taken out of every colonist's and animal's allowed area, including Unrestricted ones: they won't work there, they leave it if they're inside, and they avoid walking through it. Drafted pawns ignore it.
LanguageData.Ordo_DisallowedZone_ClearDesc: Remove cells from the disallowed zone.
LanguageData.Ordo_DisallowedZone_ToggleDesc: Switch the disallowed zone on or off. While it's on, colonists and animals treat it as outside their allowed area.
LanguageData.Ordo_DisallowedZone_ToggleTip: Disallowed zone: while on, colonists and animals treat the zone as outside their allowed area.
LanguageData.Ordo_DisallowedZone_AlertDesc: A disallowed zone is switched on. Colonists and animals treat it as outside their allowed area until you switch it off.\n\nMaps: {0}
